brief: Prioritise Aldergrove Bend (SUB-SGW-548) for pre-event attention before the forecast heat event, as its advanced age of 44 years and history of high loading reduce its margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress (MG-023). Because this unit has overdue detailed inspection, bring forward the inspection in preference to accepting exposure, as its cooling system is unverified (REG-042). If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
